content.text: {"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot \"accessory\" is for an item no other slot fits.", "\"is_outfit\" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following \"answer_schema\", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": ["\"description\" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "A structured wool-blend blazer in charcoal grey (#3a4045), tailored with notched lapels and a single-breasted cut that hits at the hip, falling to mid-thigh length, paired with high-waisted pleated trousers in matching charcoal wool. Underneath, a crisp white poplin button-down shirt with a classic collar and long sleeves, tucked neatly into the waistband for a polished look. Completing the ensemble are pointed-toe leather pumps in deep burgundy (#6d2c41), reaching mid-calf with a moderate heel.\n\nThis outfit works perfectly for an office setting in autumn by balancing professional structure with seasonal warmth; the charcoal tones provide a sophisticated, neutral base that flatters her skin while the burgundy shoes add a subtle pop of color without being distracting. The tailored blazer and pleated trousers create a streamlined silhouette appropriate for a \"neat\" dress code, ensuring she feels confident and put-together throughout the workday."}
